WHO WE ARE

Different journeys.
One shared belief.

Team 100 is a community of changemakers committed to giving every child a joyful beginning.

We are a group of individuals supporting the cause of early childhood education with our time, money, energy and intellect.

01 / EMPOWER

TRAINING & CAPACITY BUILDING

When teachers grow,
children flourish.

Monthly training for Anganwadi teachers helps turn everyday classroom moments into opportunities to learn.

StorytellingPlay-based learningLearning outcomesPhysical development
Support our educators ↗
02 / NURTURE

SHIKSHA KI ORE

A little learning.
Every single day.

We appoint teachers in Anganwadis to provide daily learning support for 25–30 children at each centre.

Alongside classroom learning, the program includes events and support for parents.

Be part of their beginning ↗
03 / CONNECT

YOUTH VOLUNTEERS

Weekend activities time.
Building confidence and connection.

400+ volunteers bring energy and encouragement through weekend activities, drama and games.

Playful experiences help children build confidence and social-emotional skills, one connection at a time.
